notes.title: Update 2025-07-28: Controller Support and many small fixes
10 Days Till Release and the Deactivation of the Demo
notes.notes:
[p]The Demons Told Me to Make This Game is coming out in 10 days![/p][p]I hope you're as excited as we are.[/p][p]For the full version of the game, we have substantially reworked the saving system. It includes three save slots now, allowing for three playthroughs.[/p][p]Unfortunately, there's a downside to this upgrade: the saves from the demo are not compatible with the release version of the game anymore. [/p][p]This is why we're deactivating the demo. To all who played it, streamed it, reviewed it, or helped us with feedback: thank you so much! Your contribution was invaluable and we can't express how much it means to us.[/p][p]We hope that a dozen achievements scattered around the prologue Loop will brighten your experience as you replay it.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon and don't forget to
WATCH OUT FOR BEES.[/p][p][/p][p]Haunted Dude[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We Have a Release Date: July 21
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]Thank you for staying tuned and for playing our demo! We can't express how much we appreciate your feedback ❤️[/p][p]We're working full steam now, preparing the game for release. And now, that Steam Next Fest is over, we are ready to announce the release date![/p][h2][b]The Demons will speak to you on July, 21, 5 P.M. EEST.[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]See you soon!
Haunted Dude[/p]
